hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains hospitalized under continuous medical monitoring due to an intestinal obstruction complicated by bronchopneumonia, prompting vigils and intense public concern among his supporters. Meanwhile, political fallout continues over shifting alignments following the departure of U.S. and allied figures linked to the family.
hotspots.affect: Combines intense health anxiety and personal sympathy for a key movement figure with escalating geopolitical friction.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: As Spain's snap general election approaches on November 29, Vox has intensified its campaign rhetoric around public safety, female voter appeal, and anti-immigration measures. Figures like Ignacio Garriga and Santiago Abascal frame the vote as a historic turning point against socialist policies, drawing fierce opposition from traditional parties.
hotspots.affect: Heightened electoral urgency and polarization over immigration and cultural preservation fuel maximum affective investment.

hotspots.title: Péter Magyar Meets Zelenskyy in Historic Transcarpathian Summit
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian politics is roiled by the high-profile meeting between Tisza Party leader Péter Magyar and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Uzhhorod. Fidesz figures have reacted with outrage and mockery, accusing Magyar of engaging in inappropriate stunts and abandoning national interests regarding Ukraine's EU integration.
hotspots.affect: Triggers fierce partisan division and accusations of betrayal over national sovereignty and foreign policy alignment.

hotspots.title: Swedish Government Crisis & SD Coalition Negotiations
hotspots.blurb: Sweden faces mounting political turbulence as Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson attempts to navigate a fragile parliamentary landscape and form a new four-party government. Sverigedemokraterna (SD), led by Jimmie Åkesson, holds decisive leverage, prompting fierce debates across the political spectrum over potential cooperation and budget demands.
hotspots.affect: Intense institutional suspense and strategic positioning as far-right kingmakers reshape parliamentary dynamics.

hotspots.title: Trump Backlash Over Reinstating Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump's administration faces sustained right-wing and populist backlash following policy moves and interventions surrounding tech figures like Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Critics within conservative circles and media outlets express alarm over cozy arrangements between political leadership and corporate elites.
hotspots.affect: A rare intersection of populist grievance and establishment skepticism creating friction within MAGA discourse.
